intro_en: In this lesson you'll learn how to tell a friend that you can't sleep, using words like нойргүйдэл (insomnia), сэрэх (to wake up) and хурхирах (to snore). You'll also practice the Mongolian pattern -гүй болох for losing a state, as in нойргүй болсон (I've become sleepless).
intro_mn: Энэ хичээлээр та англи хэлээр нойргүйдлээ найздаа хэрхэн ярихыг сурна. Мөн get/become + тэмдэг нэр (get tired, become sleepy) гэсэн бүтцийг дадлагажуулна.

vocab.example_mn: Кофе уусан болохоор нойр хүрэхгүй байна.
vocab.example_en: I drank coffee, so I'm not sleepy.

vocab.example_mn: Гадаа чимээ ихтэй болохоор унтаж чадахгүй байна.
vocab.example_en: It's so noisy outside that I can't sleep.

vocab.example_mn: Би өчигдөр шөнө гурван удаа сэрсэн.
vocab.example_en: I woke up three times last night.

vocab.example_mn: Ажлын дараа би маш их ядарсан.
vocab.example_en: I got really tired after work.
I keep feeling drowsy in class.
I drank cold water and woke right up.

vocab.example_mn: Эмч надад нойрны эм бичиж өгсөн.
vocab.example_en: The doctor prescribed me sleeping pills.

sentences.mn: Ажилгүй болсноос хойш би нойргүй болсон.
sentences.en: Since I lost my job, I haven't been able to sleep.
alt_en: Since I lost my job, I've become sleepless.
I haven't been able to sleep since I lost my job.
sentences.mn_latin: Ajilgüi bolsnoos khoish bi noirgüi bolson.

sentences.mn: Орондоо ороод хоёр цаг болсон ч нойр хүрэхгүй байна.
sentences.en: I've been in bed for two hours, but I still don't feel sleepy.
alt_en: I've been in bed for two hours, but I still can't fall asleep.
sentences.mn_latin: Orondoo orood khoyor tsag bolson ch noir khürekhgüi baina.

sentences.mn: Шөнө дунд сэрчихээд дахиж унтаж чадахгүй байна.
sentences.en: I wake up in the middle of the night and can't get back to sleep.
alt_mn: Шөнө дунд сэрээд дахиж унтаж чадахгүй байна.
alt_en: I wake up in the middle of the night and can't fall asleep again.
sentences.mn_latin: Shönö dund serchikheed dakhij untaj chadakhgüi baina.

sentences.mn: Нөхөр маань чанга хурхирдаг болохоор би сайн унтаж чадахгүй.
sentences.en: My husband snores loudly, so I can't sleep well.
alt_en: I can't sleep well because my husband snores loudly.
sentences.mn_latin: Nökhör maani changa khurkhirdag bolokhoor bi sain untaj chadakhgüi.

sentences.mn: Унтахын өмнө утас удаан ширтвэл нойр хүрэхгүй болдог.
sentences.en: If you stare at your phone for a long time before bed, you stop feeling sleepy.
alt_en: If you look at your phone for too long before bed, you stop feeling sleepy.
sentences.mn_latin: Untakhyn ömnö utas udaan shirtvel noir khürekhgüi boldog.

sentences.mn: Орой кофе уусан болохоор огт нойр хүрэхгүй байна.
sentences.en: I had coffee in the evening, so I'm not sleepy at all.
alt_en: I drank coffee in the evening, so I'm not sleepy at all.
sentences.mn_latin: Oroi kofye uusan bolokhoor ogt noir khürekhgüi baina.

sentences.mn: Үдээс хойш их ядраад нойр хүрдэг.
sentences.en: In the afternoon I get really tired and sleepy.
alt_en: I get very tired and sleepy in the afternoon.
sentences.mn_latin: Üdees khoish ikh yadraad noir khürdeg.

sentences.mn: Эмч миний нойргүйдэл стрессээс болж байгаа гэж хэлсэн.
sentences.en: The doctor said my insomnia is caused by stress.
alt_en: The doctor said my insomnia comes from stress.
sentences.mn_latin: Emch minii noirgüidel stryessees bolj baigaa gej khelsen.

sentences.mn: Шөнөжин нойргүй хоносон болохоор өдөржин толгой өвдлөө.
sentences.en: I didn't sleep all night, so I had a headache all day.
alt_en: I was up all night, so I had a headache all day.
sentences.mn_latin: Shönöjin noirgüi khonoson bolokhoor ödörjin tolgoi övdlöö.

sentences.mn: Цагаан сарын үеэр олон зочин ирээд бид бараг нойргүй болсон.
sentences.en: So many guests came during Tsagaan Sar that we got almost no sleep.
alt_en: During Tsagaan Sar so many guests came that we barely slept.
sentences.mn_latin: Tsagaan saryn üyeer olon zochin ireed bid barag noirgüi bolson.

sentences.mn: Унтахын өмнө халуун сүү уугаад үзээч, нойр хүрч магадгүй.
sentences.en: Try drinking warm milk before bed. You might get sleepy.
alt_en: Try having some warm milk before bed. It might make you sleepy.
sentences.mn_latin: Untakhyn ömnö khaluun süü uugaad üzeech, noir khürch magadgüi.

sentences.mn: Би их ядарсан ч гэсэн хэвтэнгүүтээ сэргэчихдэг.
sentences.en: Even when I'm exhausted, I become wide awake as soon as I lie down.
alt_mn: Би их ядарсан ч хэвтэнгүүтээ сэргэчихдэг.
alt_en: Even when I'm really tired, I wake right up as soon as I lie down.
sentences.mn_latin: Bi ikh yadarsan ch gesen khevtengüütee sergechikhdeg.

grammar.explain_en: In Mongolian, -гүй means "without." Add болох ("to become") and you get "to end up without something," or "to lose a state." So нойр (sleep) becomes нойргүй болсон, "I've become sleepless." Likewise ажил becomes ажилгүй болох, "to lose one's job," and цэнэг becomes цэнэггүй болох, "to run out of battery." It also works after negative verb forms: нойр хүрэхгүй болсон means "I stopped feeling sleepy," and унтаж чадахгүй болсон means "I became unable to sleep." Good news: -гүй never changes for vowel harmony.
grammar.explain_mn: Англи хэлэнд хүн ямар нэг байдалд шилжихийг get эсвэл become + тэмдэг нэрээр илэрхийлдэг. Жишээ нь get tired (ядрах), get sleepy (нойр хүрэх), become sleepy (нойрмоглох). Ярианд get илүү түгээмэл, become арай албан ёсны сонсогддог. Get-ийн дараа нэр үг (tiredness) биш, тэмдэг нэр (tired) хэрэглэдгийг санаарай. Харин "унтаж эхлэх" гэдгийг fall asleep гэсэн тогтвортой хэллэгээр хэлдэг: I can't fall asleep.

examples.mn: Хүүхэд төрснөөс хойш бид нойргүй болсон.
examples.en: Since the baby was born, we've barely slept.
examples.mn_latin: Khüükhed törsnöös khoish bid noirgüi bolson.

examples.mn: Орой болох тусам ядарч, нойр хүрдэг.
examples.en: I get tired and sleepy as the evening goes on.
examples.mn_latin: Oroi bolokh tusam yadarch, noir khürdeg.

examples.mn: Кофе уусны дараа нойр хүрэхгүй болсон.
examples.en: After drinking coffee, I stopped feeling sleepy.
examples.mn_latin: Kofye uusny daraa noir khürekhgüi bolson.

fill_blank.text: Ажилгүй болсноос хойш би нойр___ болсон.
fill_blank.translation: Since I lost my job, I haven't been able to sleep.
fill_blank.explain_en: -гүй + болох means losing a state: нойргүй болсон means "became sleepless." The ending -той would mean "with sleep," which is the opposite.
fill_blank.explain_mn: "-гүй болох" нь ямар нэг байдлаа алдахыг илэрхийлнэ. Англиар "I haven't been able to sleep" гэнэ.

fill_blank.translation: My husband snores loudly every night.
fill_blank.explain_en: Чанга (loudly) fits snoring. The -даг ending shows a habit, so хурхирдаг means "snores."
fill_blank.explain_mn: Англи хэлэнд давтагддаг үйлдлийг одоо цагаар хэлдэг: snores every night.

fill_blank.text: Би шөнө дунд ___ дахиж унтаж чадаагүй.
fill_blank.translation: I woke up in the middle of the night and couldn't fall asleep again.
fill_blank.explain_en: You can't fall asleep "again" unless you first woke up. Сэрээд means "having woken up, and then..."
fill_blank.explain_mn: Англиар "woke up ... and couldn't fall asleep again" гэж хоёр үйлдлийг and-аар холбоно.

fill_blank.text: After the long flight, I got really ___.
fill_blank.translation: Урт нислэгийн дараа би их ядарсан.
fill_blank.explain_en: After get, use an adjective that describes your state: tired. Tiring describes the thing that makes you tired.
fill_blank.explain_mn: get-ийн дараа хүний байдлыг илэрхийлэх тэмдэг нэр (tired) орно. Tiring нь "ядаргаатай, ядраадаг" гэсэн утгатай бөгөөд хүнийг ядраадаг зүйлийг тодорхойлдог.

fill_blank.text: It's midnight and I still can't fall ___.
fill_blank.translation: Шөнө дунд болчихсон ч би унтаж чадахгүй байна.
fill_blank.explain_en: "Fall asleep" is a fixed phrase meaning to start sleeping.
fill_blank.explain_mn: "Fall asleep" (унтаж эхлэх) нь тогтвортой хэллэг. Fall sleepy эсвэл fall sleep гэж хэлдэггүй.

fill_blank.translation: Халуун сүү уувал надад нойр хүрдэг.
fill_blank.explain_en: After help + person, use the base form of the verb: helps me get.
fill_blank.explain_mn: help + хүн бүтцийн дараа үйл үг үндсэн хэлбэрээрээ орно: helps me get sleepy.

dialogue.speaker: Bold
dialogue.mn: Сараа, чи их ядарсан харагдаж байна. Юу болов?
dialogue.en: Saraa, you look really tired. What's going on?
dialogue.mn_latin: Saraa, chi ikh yadarsan kharagdaj baina. Yuu bolov?

dialogue.speaker: Saraa
dialogue.mn: Сүүлийн үед нойргүй болчихлоо. Хоёр гурван цаг хэвтээд ч нойр хүрэхгүй байна.
dialogue.en: I haven't been able to sleep lately. I lie there for two or three hours and still don't get sleepy.
dialogue.mn_latin: Süüliin üyed noirgüi bolchikhloo. Khoyor gurvan tsag khevteed ch noir khürekhgüi baina.

dialogue.speaker: Bold
dialogue.mn: Ажлаасаа болж стресстэй байгаа юм биш биз?
dialogue.en: You're not stressed out about work, are you?
dialogue.mn_latin: Ajlaasaa bolj stryesstei baigaa yum bish biz?

dialogue.speaker: Saraa
dialogue.mn: Магадгүй. Тэгээд унтсан ч шөнө дунд сэрчихээд дахиж унтаж чадахгүй.
dialogue.en: Maybe. And even when I do fall asleep, I wake up in the middle of the night and can't get back to sleep.
dialogue.mn_latin: Magadgüi. Tegeed untsan ch shönö dund serchikheed dakhij untaj chadakhgüi.

dialogue.speaker: Bold
dialogue.mn: Би ч гэсэн тийм байсан. Унтахын өмнө утсаа хол тавиад ном уншдаг болсон чинь гайгүй болсон.
dialogue.en: I had the same problem. Then I started putting my phone away and reading before bed, and it got better.
dialogue.mn_latin: Bi ch gesen tiim baisan. Untakhyn ömnö utsaa khol taviad nom unshdag bolson chini gaigüi bolson.

dialogue.speaker: Saraa
dialogue.mn: Тэгвэл би ч бас оролдоод үзье. Гэхдээ манай эгч хажууд маань хурхирдаг юм.
dialogue.en: Then I'll give it a try too. But my older sister snores right next to me.
dialogue.mn_latin: Tegvel bi ch bas oroldood üziye. Gekhdee manai egch khajuud maani khurkhirdag yum.

dialogue.speaker: Bold
dialogue.mn: Тэгвэл чихний бөглөө аваарай. Эмийн санд байдаг.
dialogue.en: Then get some earplugs. Pharmacies have them.
dialogue.mn_latin: Tegvel chikhnii böglöö avaarai. Emiin sand baidag.

dialogue.speaker: Saraa
dialogue.mn: Баярлалаа. Өнөө орой эрт нойр хүрээсэй.
dialogue.en: Thanks. I hope I get sleepy early tonight.
dialogue.mn_latin: Bayarlalaa. Önöö oroi ert noir khüreesei.

culture_note.en: Traditionally, a whole Mongolian family slept in one ger, so snoring and sharing sleeping space were simply part of life. Even today, many families in Ulaanbaatar's ger districts and small apartments share rooms. When you can't sleep, a common piece of advice is to drink something warm, like milk or milk tea, before bed.
culture_note.mn: Уламжлалаар монгол айл бүхэлдээ нэг гэрт унтдаг байсан тул хурхирах, нэг дор хамт унтах нь энгийн зүйл байжээ. Өнөөдөр ч Улаанбаатарын гэр хороолол, жижиг байранд олон айлын гэр бүлийн гишүүд нэг өрөөнд хамт унтдаг. Нойр хүрэхгүй үед унтахын өмнө халуун сүү эсвэл сүүтэй цай уугаарай гэж зөвлөх нь түгээмэл.

review.notes: Solid, natural lesson. There are minor issues in a few back-translations and one gloss in an explanation.

opus_fix.notes: A solid lesson; the fixes cover a time expression, the subject with нойр хүрэх, one English tense and a culture-note mismatch.

changes.why: "өнөө шөнө" means tonight; the English says last night
нойр хүрэх is not used with a nominative "би" as its subject; dropping the subject fixes it
same problem with "би" and нойр хүрэх
the old wording meant several families sleep in one room; the English means family members share rooms
